text:
In the open Bitwig project, the “Rain Steps” drums have a groove I like. I’ve removed the “Undertow” bass clip. Write a new bass clip in Scene 1 using the existing bass sound, with the same loop length as the drums.
Take the timing feel from the drums so the bass sounds like it belongs in the same pocket. Keep the drums unchanged. Keep track of the bass’s underlying rhythm and how each note sits ahead of or behind it, alongside the clip, so we can revise the feel later without guessing from the shifted notes. If I move some notes by hand, we should be able to tell which parts of that interpretation still apply.
Use Ghostnote and computer control as you see fit, then start Scene 1 so I can hear it.
I’ll inspect the drum groove, create a bass clip with editable timing references, and start Scene 1 for listening.
